makes-network-calls.question: Does `content` make network calls to an external service?
makes-network-calls.true: The code opens HTTP or socket connections, or calls a remote API
makes-network-calls.false: The code only computes locally, reads local files, or calls injected functions without doing network I/O itself

arch-layer.question: Which architectural layer does `content` belong to?

options.transport: Network client, HTTP requests, retries, rate limits, budgets for remote calls
options.domain_logic: Core decision rules, policy, thresholds, pure business logic
options.orchestration: Glue that wires components together, file I/O, registries, command runners
